limitations: No model is a measured as-built digital twin.
Source footprints establish geography. Selected interior cores and architectural envelopes are interpretations.
No downloaded photograph, copyrighted collection image or third-party 3D mesh is shipped as an asset.
Not every facade or room has photographic coverage. Described research features and original inferred details are distinguished below.

photoReferences.reviewed: Visual inspection of facade photo: three round portals, mosaics, central arched window and triangular pediment.
Visual inspection: three monumental arches, terracotta eaves, clerestory, fountain plaza.
Visual inspection: central stage, terraced red seating, suspended cream acoustic sails and timber cloud.
Direct visual inspection of architect photo: rusticated tall arch, green recessed glazing, carved name plaque, terracotta tile roof and eave details.
Direct visual inspection of official atrium photo: timber bleacher steps, two flanking stairs, glass rails, gray floor, large glazed entrance.
Official architectural rendering used only to corroborate pavilion massing; not proof of current furnishings.
